description: codex-cli: approval-squash path — the trust-folder modal is rendered as a compacted single-line blob; squash builder must recover message + buttons via parseApproval; detectStatus returns null (no regular modal/spinner cue) and the daemon's outer policy preserves last-known status

anchors.name: squashed trust-folder modal

parseApproval.message: Do you trust the contents of this directory?

anchors.notes: The terminal has compacted the trust-folder modal into a single lowercase alnum blob. detectStatus returns null because the regular modal questionPattern does not match the compacted text; the daemon's outer state machine preserves the last-known status. parseApproval via the squash builder matches 'doyoutrustthecontentsofthisdirectory' cue + finds the '1yescontinue2noquit' button rule. This is the regression anchor for the squash detection path.

anchors.name: settled after squash
anchors.notes: After the squashed modal and subsequent output scroll the compacted blob beyond the squash builder's 24-line tail window, parseApproval returns null. The settled prompt (›) with 'tab to queue message' footer triggers the settled-prompt primitive and detectStatus returns idle.
